voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: The best time is sunrise; climb a hill while the balloons are up. Entry to the Open Air Museum is paid, and the Turkish museum pass is valid. The Dark Church may cost extra. Local tip: even without a balloon ride, watch the sunrise from a hill. Nobody charges for that view. Your next stop is the Zelve open-air site, about three kilometres by car, around ten minutes.
